# Online Supplementary Material

## Overview participating centres


```{r tablecenter, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    setting[c("center.id", "or.id", "anaesthesia.machine", "water.trap")],
    col.names = c("Centre", "OR", "Anaesthesia machine", "Water trap"),
    caption = paste0(
        "Details of participating centres. OR: operating room. ",
        "Centre identifiers were assigned at recruitment and are not consecutive."
    )
)
```


```{r table-center-or, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
or_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    split(agcs, agcs$or),
    function(x) {
        fin <- x[is.na(x$exclusion.reason), ]
        data.frame(
            center       = x$center[1L],
            or           = x$or[1L],
            n.agcs.total = nrow(x),
            n.agcs.final = nrow(fin),
            n.cases      = if (nrow(fin) > 0L) sum(fin$n.cases) else NA_real_,
            n.bottles    = if (nrow(fin) > 0L) round(sum(fin$avg.bottles), 1) else NA_real_,
            water.trap   = ifelse(x$water.trap[1L] == 1, "Yes", "No"),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }
))
or_tbl <- or_tbl[order(or_tbl$center, or_tbl$or), ]
rownames(or_tbl) <- NULL

knitr::kable(
    or_tbl,
    col.names = c("Centre", "OR", "AGCs deployed", "AGCs analysed",
                  "Cases analysed", "Bottles (est.)", "Water trap"),
    caption = paste0(
        "Canisters deployed and analysed by centre and operating room. ",
        "AGCs deployed: all canisters used during the study period; ",
        "AGCs analysed: canisters included in the final analysis (batch ", zeosys_batch, "); ",
        "Cases analysed: anaesthesia cases recorded for analysed canisters; ",
        "Bottles (est.): sevoflurane bottles attributed to analysed canisters by proportional allocation."
    ),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na.string = "—"
)
```

## Case mix by canister

```{r case-mix-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = paste0('Proportion of inhalational anaesthesia (purple) and TIVA (green) cases for each of the ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters, sorted in ascending order of the inhalational anaesthesia proportion. Each bar represents one canister.')}
fa_cm <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

n_inha_cols <- grep("^n\\.cases.*inha", names(fa_cm), value = TRUE)
n_tiva_cols <- grep("^n\\.cases.*tiva", names(fa_cm), value = TRUE)

n_inha <- rowSums(fa_cm[, n_inha_cols, drop = FALSE])
n_tiva <- rowSums(fa_cm[, n_tiva_cols, drop = FALSE])
n_tot  <- n_inha + n_tiva
n_tot[n_tot == 0L] <- 1L

ord <- order(n_inha / n_tot)

bar_mat <- rbind(
    n_inha[ord] / n_tot[ord] * 100,
    n_tiva[ord] / n_tot[ord] * 100
)

op <- par(mar = c(3.5, 4.5, 2, 0.5))
barplot(
    bar_mat,
    beside    = FALSE,
    col       = c(col_primary, col_secondary),
    border    = NA,
    space     = 0.15,
    ylab      = "Proportion of cases (%)",
    las       = 1,
    axisnames = FALSE,
    ylim      = c(0, 100)
)
mtext(
    paste0("Canister (n = ", ncol(bar_mat),
           ", sorted by proportion of inhalational anaesthesia)"),
    side = 1, line = 2.5, cex = 0.9
)
legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.16), xpd = TRUE, horiz = TRUE,
       legend = c("Inhalational anaesthesia", "TIVA"),
       fill   = c(col_primary, col_secondary),
       border = NA,
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
par(op)
```

## Weight gain by centre

```{r weight-gain-distribution-by-centre, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = paste0('Weight gain (in vivo mass transfer, ΔW₀) for all ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters, grouped by participating centre and, within each centre, ranked by weight gain in ascending order. Each bar represents one canister; colour and the number below the axis indicate the centre. Black borders denote canisters equipped with a water trap, grey borders those without. The dashed horizontal line marks the overall median weight gain.')}
wg_data_ctr <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

ctr_lvls <- sort(unique(wg_data_ctr$center))
n_ctr    <- length(ctr_lvls)
ctr_pal  <- setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(n_ctr, palette = "Viridis"),
    ctr_lvls
)

wg_data_ctr$center <- factor(wg_data_ctr$center, levels = ctr_lvls)
ctr_order <- rev(order(tapply(wg_data_ctr$weight.gain, wg_data_ctr$center, median)))
wg_data_ctr$center <- factor(wg_data_ctr$center, levels = ctr_lvls[ctr_order])
wg_data_ctr <- wg_data_ctr[order(wg_data_ctr$center, wg_data_ctr$weight.gain), ]

new_group   <- c(FALSE, diff(as.numeric(factor(wg_data_ctr$center))) != 0)
space_vec   <- ifelse(new_group, 1, 0.15)

op <- par(mar = c(4, 4.5, 3.5, 0.5))
bar_pos_ctr <- barplot(
    wg_data_ctr$weight.gain,
    col       = ctr_pal[as.integer(wg_data_ctr$center)],
    border    = ifelse(wg_data_ctr$water.trap == 1L, "black", "grey70"),
    space     = space_vec,
    xlab      = "Canister (grouped by centre, ranked by weight gain within centre)",
    ylab      = "Weight gain (g)",
    ylim      = c(0, max(wg_data_ctr$weight.gain) * 1.15),
    las       = 1,
    axisnames = FALSE
)
grp_mid <- tapply(bar_pos_ctr[, 1], wg_data_ctr$center, mean)
mtext(names(grp_mid), side = 1, at = grp_mid, line = 0.3, cex = 0.6)
abline(h = median(wg_data_ctr$weight.gain), lty = 2, col = col_ref)

legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.16), xpd = TRUE, horiz = TRUE,
       legend = c("Water trap", "No water trap"),
       fill   = "white",
       border = c("black", "grey70"),
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
par(op)
```

## Weight gain by anaesthesia machine

```{r machine-weight-gain-boxplot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.cap = paste0('Weight gain by anaesthesia machine for all ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters. Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to 1.5 × IQR. Individual data points are overlaid (jittered); diamonds denote canisters equipped with a water trap, circles those without.')}
wg_mach <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]
setting$or_key <- sprintf("%02.f-%02.f", setting$center.id, setting$or.id)
wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine <- setting$anaesthesia.machine[
    match(wg_mach$or, setting$or_key)]

machine_order <- names(sort(tapply(
    wg_mach$weight.gain, wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
wg_mach_list <- setNames(
    lapply(machine_order, function(m)
        wg_mach$weight.gain[wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine == m]),
    machine_order)

set.seed(20260517)
op <- par(mar = c(8, 4.5, 2, 0.5))
boxplot(
    wg_mach_list,
    col        = adjustcolor("grey90", alpha.f = 0.5),
    border     = "grey30",
    xlab       = "",
    ylab       = "Weight gain (g)",
    ## outline = FALSE would size the axis from box and whiskers only
    ## and silently clip the overlaid raw points below them
    ylim       = grDevices::extendrange(wg_mach$weight.gain, f = 0.04),
    xaxt       = "n",
    frame.plot = TRUE,
    outline    = FALSE
)
## machine names are long; 45 degrees needs far less vertical space than las = 2
axis(1L, at = seq_along(machine_order), labels = FALSE)
text(
    x      = seq_along(machine_order),
    y      = par("usr")[3L] - 0.03 * diff(par("usr")[3:4]),
    labels = machine_order,
    srt    = 45, adj = 1, xpd = NA, cex = 0.9
)
for (i in seq_along(machine_order)) {
    idx      <- which(wg_mach$anaesthesia.machine == machine_order[i])
    y_vals   <- wg_mach$weight.gain[idx]
    wt_vals  <- wg_mach$water.trap[idx]
    x_vals   <- jitter(rep(i, length(idx)), amount = 0.12)
    points(x_vals[wt_vals == 0L], y_vals[wt_vals == 0L],
           pch = 21L, col = col_ref,
           bg  = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.8),
           cex = 0.8)
    points(x_vals[wt_vals == 1L], y_vals[wt_vals == 1L],
           pch = 23L, col = col_ref,
           bg  = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.8),
           cex = 0.8)
}
legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.09), xpd = TRUE, horiz = TRUE,
       legend = c("Water trap", "No water trap"),
       pch    = c(23L, 21L),
       col    = col_ref,
       pt.bg  = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.8),
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex)
par(op)
```

## Weight gain by water trap use

```{r supp-boxplot-setup, include = FALSE}
final_agcs$wt.label <- factor(
    ifelse(final_agcs$water.trap == 1L, "With water trap", "Without water trap"),
    levels = c("Without water trap", "With water trap")
)
```

```{r fig-add-01-water-trap, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = paste0("Weight gain by water trap use for all ", n_agcs['final'], " analysed canisters.")}
.boxjitter(
    split(final_agcs$weight.gain, final_agcs$wt.label),
    cols = c(col_secondary, col_primary),
    ylab = "Weight gain (g)"
)
```

```{r watertrap-weightgain-test, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
wg_wt_data <- final_agcs[!is.na(final_agcs$weight.gain), ]
wg_wt_grps <- split(wg_wt_data$weight.gain, wg_wt_data$wt.label)

wg_wt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(wg_wt_grps, function(x)
    data.frame(
        n      = length(x),
        median = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        IQR    = round(IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    )
))
wg_wt_summary <- cbind("Water trap" = rownames(wg_wt_summary), wg_wt_summary)
rownames(wg_wt_summary) <- NULL

knitr::kable(
    wg_wt_summary,
    col.names = c("Water trap", "n", "Median weight gain (g)", "IQR (g)"),
    caption   = "Weight gain by water trap use."
)

wg_wt_test <- wilcox.test(weight.gain ~ wt.label, data = wg_wt_data, exact = FALSE)
```

Weight gain was compared between canisters with and without a water trap
using a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
There was `r if (wg_wt_test$p.value < 0.05) "a statistically significant" else "no statistically significant"`
difference in weight gain between groups
(W = `r round(wg_wt_test$statistic, 0)`,
p `r ifelse(wg_wt_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", format.pval(wg_wt_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))`).
Only one centre used both configurations
so this comparison also reflects centre-level differences.

## Weight loss during storage

```{r weight-loss-storage-setup, include = FALSE}
wl_data             <- agcs[!is.na(agcs$weight.diff), ]
wl_data$weight.loss <- -wl_data$weight.diff

fit_wl  <- lm(weight.loss ~ weight.gain, data = wl_data)
wl_cf   <- coef(fit_wl)
wl_ci   <- confint(fit_wl)
wl_smry <- summary(fit_wl)
```

```{r weight-loss-storage-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = paste0("Weight loss between the first and second ZeoSys weighing as a function of weight gain for all analysed canisters (n = ", nrow(wl_data), "). The line shows the fitted linear regression; the shaded band is the 95% confidence interval.")}
x_seq <- seq(min(wl_data$weight.gain), max(wl_data$weight.gain), length.out = 200)
pred  <- predict(fit_wl,
                 newdata  = data.frame(weight.gain = x_seq),
                 interval = "confidence")

plot(
    wl_data$weight.gain, wl_data$weight.loss,
    xlab = "Weight gain (g)",
    ylab = "Weight loss during storage (g)",
    pch  = pt_pch,
    col  = adjustcolor(col_primary, alpha.f = pt_alpha),
    las  = 1,
    bty  = "l"
)
polygon(
    c(x_seq, rev(x_seq)),
    c(pred[, "lwr"], rev(pred[, "upr"])),
    col    = col_band(),
    border = NA
)
lines(x_seq, pred[, "fit"], col = col_primary, lwd = 2)
```

Weight loss during storage was modelled by linear regression of the absolute weight difference (W1 − W2)
on canister weight gain.
The estimated weight loss per gram of weight gain was
`r round(wl_cf["weight.gain"], 3)` g
(95% CI `r round(wl_ci["weight.gain", 1], 3)` to `r round(wl_ci["weight.gain", 2], 3)`),
and the intercept was
`r round(wl_cf["(Intercept)"], 2)` g
(95% CI `r round(wl_ci["(Intercept)", 1], 2)` to `r round(wl_ci["(Intercept)", 2], 2)`);
R² = `r round(wl_smry$r.squared, 2)`.

## Predictor correlations

```{r predictor-correlation-prose, include = FALSE}
## correlation of case count and cumulative duration within each stratum
strata <- sub("^n\\.cases\\.", "",
              grep("^n\\.cases\\.", colnames(X_all), value = TRUE))
ncases_dur_r <- vapply(strata, function(st)
    cor(X_all[, paste0("n.cases.", st)], X_all[, paste0("sum.dur.", st)]), NA_real_)
```

Within each stratum the case count and the cumulative case duration
measured almost the same quantity
(r `r sprintf("%.2f", min(ncases_dur_r))` to `r sprintf("%.2f", max(ncases_dur_r))`).

```{r predictor-correlations, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6.5, fig.cap = paste0("Pairwise Pearson correlations among the ", length(clustering_columns), " candidate variables considered for the LASSO model. Predictors with zero variance are excluded. Rows and columns are ordered by hierarchical clustering (correlation distance). Purple: positive correlation; green: negative correlation. Abbreviations: n, case count; dur, cumulative duration; flow, median fresh gas flow; LM, laryngeal mask; TU, tracheal tube; nl, non-laparoscopic; l, laparoscopic; IA, inhalational anaesthesia; TV, TIVA.")}
## remove zero-variance columns (e.g. subgroups with no cases across all ORs)
X_var    <- X_all[, apply(X_all, 2, var) > 0, drop = FALSE]
cor_mat  <- cor(X_var)

## shorten variable names for display
sn <- colnames(X_var)
sn <- sub("^n\\.cases\\.",  "n.",    sn)
sn <- sub("^sum\\.dur\\.",  "dur.",  sn)
sn <- sub("^med\\.flow\\.", "flow.", sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.nonlap",     ".nl",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.lap$",       ".l",    sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.lap\\.",     ".l.",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.inha$",      ".IA",   sn)
sn <- gsub("\\.tiva$",      ".TV",   sn)
sn <- gsub("lama",          "LM",    sn)
sn <- gsub("tube",          "TU",    sn)
colnames(cor_mat) <- rownames(cor_mat) <- sn

col_corr <- colorRampPalette(c(col_secondary, "white", col_primary))(100)
hc       <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_mat))

heatmap(
    cor_mat,
    Rowv    = as.dendrogram(hc),
    Colv    = "Rowv",
    col     = col_corr,
    symm    = TRUE,
    scale   = "none",
    margins = c(8, 8),
    cexRow  = 0.65,
    cexCol  = 0.65
)
```

## Stability selection

```{r stabsel-table, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    stab_df,
    col.names = c("Predictor", "Max. selection probability",
                  paste0("Selected (≥ ", round(stab_fit$cutoff, 3), ")")),
    caption = paste0(
        "Stability selection results with subsampling ",
        "(Meinshausen & Bühlmann, 2010) using rcv.glmnet (", nrepcv, " CV repetitions, ", nfolds, " folds) as inner fitter. ",
        "Maximum selection probability across the regularisation path ",
        "(sampling.type = MB, B = ", stab_fit$B, ", PFER ≤ ", pfer, ", q = ", stab_fit$q, ", nominal cutoff = ", pi_thr, "; ",
        "effective cutoff = ", round(stab_fit$cutoff, 3), " after PFER adjustment). ",
        "Predictors exceeding the effective cutoff are considered stably selected."
    )
)
```

```{r stabsel-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Maximum selection probability per predictor from stability selection. Vertical dashed line indicates the cutoff of 0.8."}
par(mar = c(4, 12, 2, 1))
barplot(
    rev(stab_df$max.prob),
    names.arg = rev(stab_df$variable),
    horiz     = TRUE,
    las       = 1,
    xlab      = "Maximum selection probability",
    xlim      = c(0, 1),
    col       = ifelse(rev(stab_df$selected) == "Yes", col_primary, col_light),
    border    = NA,
    cex.names = 0.7
)
abline(v = stab_fit$cutoff, lty = 2)
```

## Sensitivity to the per-family error rate

```{r stabsel-pfer-setup, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE, dependson = "stabsel-results", cache.extra = list(X, Y, model_params)}
set.seed(20260517)

stab_fit_pfer <- stabsel(
    x             = X,
    y             = Y,
    fitfun        = rcv_glmnet_fitfun,
    cutoff        = pi_thr,
    PFER          = pfer_sens,
    B             = nsub,
    sampling.type = "MB"
)

stopifnot(stab_fit_pfer$q == q_stabsel(pfer_sens))

## both settings side by side, ordered by the primary analysis
stab_df_pfer <- data.frame(
    variable = stab_df$variable,
    primary  = stab_df$max.prob,
    relaxed  = round(stab_fit_pfer$max[stab_df$variable], 2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(stab_df_pfer) <- NULL

## among the predictors the primary analysis separates at all, the relaxed
## setting must keep their order; the ties at zero carry no information
nz <- stab_df_pfer$primary > 0
stopifnot(!is.unsorted(rev(stab_df_pfer$relaxed[nz])))
```

```{r stabsel-pfer-prose, include = FALSE}
sel_p <- names(stab_fit$selected)
sel_r <- names(stab_fit_pfer$selected)
name_or_none <- function(x)
    if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = ", ") else "no predictor"

sens_selected <- if (identical(sel_p, sel_r)) {
    paste0("The same ",
           if (length(sel_p) == 1L) "predictor was" else "predictors were",
           " stably selected under both settings (", name_or_none(sel_p), ").")
} else {
    paste0("Stably selected under the primary setting was ", name_or_none(sel_p),
           " and under the relaxed one ", name_or_none(sel_r), ".")
}
```

The number of variables the inner LASSO may select within each subsample
follows from the per-family error rate and the selection probability cutoff.
Relaxing the per-family error rate from `r pfer` to `r pfer_sens`
raises that number from `r stab_fit$q` to `r stab_fit_pfer$q`
and raises the selection probabilities throughout.
The `r sum(nz)` predictors that the primary analysis separates keep their order.
The remaining `r sum(!nz)` are indistinguishable under the primary setting
and separate only under the relaxed one.
`r sens_selected`

```{r stabsel-pfer-table, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    stab_df_pfer,
    col.names = c("Predictor",
                  paste0("PFER \u2264 ", pfer, " (q = ", stab_fit$q, ")"),
                  paste0("PFER \u2264 ", pfer_sens, " (q = ", stab_fit_pfer$q, ")")),
    caption = paste0(
        "Maximum selection probability per predictor under the primary ",
        "per-family error rate and under a relaxed one. ",
        "All other settings are identical to Table \\@ref(tab:stabsel-table) ",
        "(sampling.type = MB, B = ", stab_fit$B, ", cutoff = ", pi_thr, "). ",
        "Rows are ordered by the primary analysis."
    )
)
```

```{r stabsel-pfer-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = paste0("Maximum selection probability per predictor under the primary per-family error rate of ", pfer, " (dark) and under a relaxed one of ", pfer_sens, " (light). Vertical dashed line indicates the cutoff of ", pi_thr, ".")}
par(mar = c(4, 12, 2, 1))
barplot(
    rbind(rev(stab_df_pfer$relaxed), rev(stab_df_pfer$primary)),
    names.arg = rev(stab_df_pfer$variable),
    beside    = TRUE,

legend("bottomright",

## Stability selection including study centre

As a sensitivity analysis,
study centre was added to the predictor set as a categorical variable
(one-hot encoded, `r n_center["final"]` centres, without a reference level given the
absence of an intercept in the underlying LASSO model)
and stability selection was repeated with otherwise identical settings.

```{r stabsel-centre-setup, include = FALSE, cache = TRUE, dependson = "penalized-regression-setup", cache.extra = list(X, Y, model_params)}
set.seed(20260517)

final_agcs_ctr <- final_agcs
final_agcs_ctr$center <- factor(final_agcs_ctr$center)

X_ctr <- model.matrix(
    reformulate(c(model_columns, "center"),
                response = "weight.gain", intercept = FALSE),
    data = final_agcs_ctr
)

stab_fit_ctr <- stabsel(
    x             = X_ctr,
    y             = Y,
    fitfun        = rcv_glmnet_fitfun,
    cutoff        = pi_thr,
    PFER          = pfer,
    B             = nsub,
    sampling.type = "MB"
)

stab_df_ctr <- data.frame(
    variable = names(stab_fit_ctr$max),
    max.prob = round(stab_fit_ctr$max, 2),
    selected = ifelse(names(stab_fit_ctr$max) %in% names(stab_fit_ctr$selected), "Yes", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stab_df_ctr <- stab_df_ctr[order(-stab_df_ctr$max.prob), ]
rownames(stab_df_ctr) <- NULL
```

```{r stabsel-centre-table, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(
    stab_df_ctr,
    col.names = c("Predictor", "Max. selection probability",
                  paste0("Selected (≥ ", round(stab_fit_ctr$cutoff, 3), ")")),
    caption = paste0(
        "Stability selection results including study centre (", n_center["final"], " centres) as an ",
        "additional categorical predictor, using rcv.glmnet (", nrepcv, " CV repetitions, ", nfolds, " folds) as inner fitter. ",
        "Maximum selection probability across the regularisation path ",
        "(sampling.type = MB, B = ", stab_fit_ctr$B, ", PFER ≤ ", pfer, ", q = ", stab_fit_ctr$q, ", nominal cutoff = ", pi_thr, "; ",
        "effective cutoff = ", round(stab_fit_ctr$cutoff, 3), " after PFER adjustment). ",
        "Predictors exceeding the effective cutoff are considered stably selected."
    )
)
```

```{r stabsel-centre-plot, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 6, fig.height = 7, fig.cap = "Maximum selection probability per predictor from stability selection including study centre as an additional predictor. Vertical dashed line indicates the effective cutoff."}
par(mar = c(4, 12, 2, 1))
barplot(
    rev(stab_df_ctr$max.prob),
    names.arg = rev(stab_df_ctr$variable),
    horiz     = TRUE,
    las       = 1,
    xlab      = "Maximum selection probability",
    xlim      = c(0, 1),
    col       = ifelse(rev(stab_df_ctr$selected) == "Yes", col_primary, col_light),
    border    = NA,
    cex.names = 0.6
)
abline(v = stab_fit_ctr$cutoff, lty = 2)
```

## R session information


```{r sessioninfo-packages, include = FALSE}
## Chunks with cache = TRUE do not attach their packages when they are restored
## from the cache, so the listing below would depend on whether the cache was
## warm. knitr records the packages of cached chunks in __packages; attaching
## them here makes the session information independent of the cache state.
## Packages already attached keep their position in the search path, so a cold
## run and a cached run produce the same listing.
local({
    f <- paste0(knitr::opts_chunk$get("cache.path"), "__packages")
    if (file.exists(f))
        for (p in readLines(f))
            suppressPackageStartupMessages(
                require(p, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)
            )
})
```

```{r sessioninfo}
sessionInfo()
```
